scope: Exploratory development comparison; fresh human evaluation follows selection
roster: Select within-record targets in fixed B order and cycle to budget before permuting each pass; each visit retains its last token as a masked input
context: Pack full record visits into 1024-token windows; all arms truncate history at the same window length. Isolated arms reset positions at each record or window start.
evaluation: Existing Canada selection/outcome windows are development evidence; no fresh-test or promotion claim
decision: Report each arm and factorial contrasts. Select candidates for a separately frozen fresh evaluation; human gates remain pending. Stop on nonfinite values or failed identity/mechanism checks.
